comments.text:
In this vlog, we are exploring some of the most beautiful destinations near Manali – Rohtang Pass, Atal Tunnel, Koksar and Sissu.

For Himachal Tour Package

✨ Places Covered in This Vlog:
* Rohtang Pass – One of the most famous mountain passes in Himachal Pradesh.
* Atal Tunnel – One of the world’s longest highway tunnels above 10,000 feet.
* Koksar – A beautiful village in Lahaul Valley.
* Sissu – A stunning Himalayan destination famous for its waterfall, lake and mountain views.
